answer: Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 5 epochs of prior interaction to count. Because the kernel history dates every edge, the jetty audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, because the summit edge has to exist before the case does. Bonded capital sits idle for 5 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
